# Spectre AI — Full Platform Reference

> Spectre AI is a crypto-native market intelligence platform that replaces the multi-tab workflow of Nansen, DeFiLlama, Dune, CoinGlass, LunarCrush, and Messari in a single surface. It combines real-time on-chain data, social intelligence, AI-powered analysis, and trading tools for both retail and institutional users.

---

## What is Spectre AI

Spectre AI is a unified crypto market intelligence platform that surfaces real-time on-chain data, AI-generated market analysis, social sentiment tracking, trading tools, and research workflows across 10,000+ cryptocurrency tokens on all major chains. It is accessible at https://spectreai.io with a developer API at https://api.spectreai.io and documentation at https://docs.spectreai.io.

The platform consolidates data from Binance, Bybit, OKX, Coinbase, Kraken, CoinGecko, DeFiLlama, TradingView, Bitquery, Polymarket, and 500+ additional sources into one surface. Each pillar is usable alone; together they replace the 5-10 tabs a professional crypto operator used to keep open.

**Founded:** November 2023. **Backing:** Google for Startups, NVIDIA Inception. **Partners:** TradingView, Bitquery.

---

## Platform Pillars

### Main (5 features)
- **Research Platform** (https://spectreai.io): Full-featured command center with AI briefs, Spectre Brain conviction, watchlists, and live market stats.
- **Monarch AI** (https://spectreai.io/monarch-chat): Conversational AI analyst with real-time market data integration. Answers questions about any token, sector, on-chain flow, or market event.
- **GM Dashboard** (https://spectreai.io/gm-dashboard): Full-screen morning dashboard with overnight market summary.
- **Discover** (https://spectreai.io/discover): Trending tokens, new listings, and curated discovery feeds.
- **YOU Dashboard** (https://spectreai.io/you): 36+ configurable widgets — drag, drop, resize, personalize.

### Research (7 features)
- **Intelligence Hub** (https://spectreai.io/intelligence): Editorial publication with hero stories, analysis columns, and breaking news.
- **Intelligence Feed** (https://spectreai.io/intelligence-feed): Curated real-time feed of market-moving intelligence and signals.
- **News Engine** (https://spectreai.io/news): Multi-source news aggregation with sentiment scoring and filtering.
- **Research Zone** (https://spectreai.io/research-zone): Deep token analysis with on-chain metrics and AI synthesis.
- **Search Engine** (https://spectreai.io/search-engine): Semantic search across 50,000+ tokens with AI ranking.
- **Ventures** (https://spectreai.io/ventures): Early-stage project tracking and venture capital deal flow.
- **Tokenized Assets** (https://spectreai.io/tokenized-assets): Real-world asset tokenization tracking.

### Trading (4 features)
- **AI Screener** (https://spectreai.io/token): Full trading terminal with chart, swap UI, and real-time data.
- **Trader's Corner** (https://spectreai.io/traders-corner): Advanced trading analysis widgets and professional tools.
- **Liquidation Heatmap** (https://spectreai.io/liquidation-heatmap): Exchange liquidation levels and funding rate visualization.
- **Predictions** (https://spectreai.io/predictions): Polymarket-powered prediction markets with live odds.

### Analysis (4 features)
- **AI Charts** (https://spectreai.io/ai-charts): AI-powered technical analysis with pattern recognition.
- **AI Charts Lab** (https://spectreai.io/ai-charts-lab): Experimental charting with custom indicators and overlays.
- **AI Market Analysis** (https://spectreai.io/ai-market-analysis): AI-generated macro thesis and sector breakdowns.
- **Economic Calendar** (https://spectreai.io/economic-calendar): 657 events from 9 sources with 4-tier impact filtering — FOMC, CPI, NFP, central banks, token unlocks.

### Visualize (4 features)
- **World Map** (https://spectreai.io/world): Global crypto activity visualization with regional heatmaps.
- **Heatmaps** (https://spectreai.io/heatmaps): 24h market performance heatmap by sector or market cap.
- **Bubbles** (https://spectreai.io/bubbles): Market cap vs price change bubble chart visualization.
- **Fear & Greed** (https://spectreai.io/fear-greed): Real-time market sentiment gauge with historical overlay.

### Social (7 features)
- **Pulse** (https://spectreai.io/pulse): Real-time 2-column social feed with curated analysis.
- **Social Zone** (https://spectreai.io/social-zone): Aggregated social metrics and trending discussions.
- **AI Media Center** (https://spectreai.io/ai-media-center): Curated video, podcasts, and market multimedia content.
- **X Dashboard** (https://spectreai.io/x-dash): Twitter analytics, engagement metrics, and conversation tracking.
- **X Intelligence** (https://spectreai.io/x-intelligence): Full-viewport social graph mapping influencer networks.
- **X Bubbles** (https://spectreai.io/x-bubbles): Visual conversation clusters showing trending topics.
- **Mindshare** (https://spectreai.io/mindshare): Track which tokens dominate the social conversation.

### Tools (3 features)
- **Watchlists** (https://spectreai.io/watchlists): Unlimited custom lists with sparklines, alerts, and tracking.
- **Categories** (https://spectreai.io/categories): Browse tokens by sector — L1, DeFi, AI, Gaming, and more.
- **Lens** (https://spectreai.io/lens): Deep-dive comparison tool for head-to-head token analysis.

### Marketplace & API (3 features)
- **API Access** (https://spectreai.io/api): 500+ RESTful and GraphQL endpoints for market data integration.
- **Widget Marketplace** (https://spectreai.io/marketplace): Community-built widgets and data visualizations.
- **Data Exports** (https://spectreai.io/exports): CSV, JSON, and webhook exports for institutional workflows.

## Developer Platform

### REST API
- Base URL: `https://api.spectreai.io`
- 500+ endpoints spanning market data, on-chain analytics, social intelligence, AI insights, news, and calendar events.
- Authentication: API key via `X-API-KEY` header, OR x402 micropayment flow, OR $SPECT token-gated access.
- Rate limits scale by tier. Free tier available.

### WebSocket Feeds
- Base URL: `wss://ws.spectreai.io`
- Real-time streaming for price ticks, order book, trades, liquidations, and social events.
- Upstream sources: Binance, Bybit, OKX, Coinbase, Kraken, Polymarket.

### MCP Server (Model Context Protocol)
- Endpoint: `https://mcp.spectreai.io`
- Exposes 24 tools to AI agents (Claude, ChatGPT, custom LLMs) for live crypto data queries: prices, sentiment, on-chain flows, fear & greed, search, news, economic calendar.
- Standardized MCP transport so agents can natively call Spectre data the same way they call filesystem or web tools.

### x402 Micropayments
- HTTP 402 "Payment Required" based protocol.
- Pay-per-request API access using cryptocurrency. No API key required.
- Ideal for AI agents and one-off integrations that don't want to hold a key.

### SDKs
- **TypeScript**: `npm install @spectreai/sdk`
- **Python**: `pip install spectreai`
- Both SDKs wrap REST, WebSocket, and x402 flows.

### Endpoint Categories
- **AI Brief** — `GET /v1/brief` — Daily AI-generated market brief with sentiment score, top movers, narrative.
- **Token Data** — `GET /v1/token/:symbol` — Full profile, price, liquidity, on-chain metrics, social stats.
- **Fear & Greed** — `GET /v1/fear-greed` — Real-time sentiment index with sub-factors.
- **On-Chain** — `GET /v1/onchain/:network/:address` — Wallet, transfer, and DEX trade streams from Bitquery.
- **Social** — `GET /v1/social/:symbol` — Mindshare, mentions, influencer activity, sentiment.
- **Intelligence** — `GET /v1/intelligence` — Curated articles and breaking news with AI classification.
- **Economic Calendar** — `GET /v1/calendar/economic` — FOMC, CPI, NFP, token unlocks, IPO dates, 4-tier impact.
- **Market** — `GET /v1/market/*` — Total cap, dominance, liquidations, sector performance, heatmap data.

## Use Cases

### For Retail Traders
Replace 5-10 tabs (CoinGecko, TradingView, X, DeFiLlama, news sites) with one surface. Get AI-generated morning brief, set watchlists, view heatmaps, receive whale alerts.

### For Professional / Institutional
API-first workflow with WebSocket feeds, historical data exports, custom dashboards, team seats, compliance tooling. Bitquery-grade on-chain data across 40+ networks.

### For Developers
MCP server plugs Spectre data directly into any AI agent. x402 micropayments mean zero onboarding friction — agents discover the API and pay per call. TypeScript and Python SDKs available for traditional key-based workflows.

### For Researchers / Journalists
Intelligence Hub publishes AI-curated analysis articles. Economic Calendar surfaces market-moving events before they hit major news. Social intelligence exposes the influence graph behind every narrative.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: What makes Spectre AI different from Nansen / DeFiLlama / Dune?**
A: Spectre unifies on-chain data, social intelligence, AI analysis, trading tools, and research into one surface. Nansen is wallet-focused, DeFiLlama is protocol TVL, Dune is SQL queries, Messari is research. Spectre is all of the above plus AI orchestration and an MCP server for AI agents.

**Q: Is there a free tier?**
A: Yes. Free users get market overview, top 100 token tracking, basic news feed, community access, and 1 watchlist. Upgrading to Pro ($SPECT-gated) unlocks AI briefs, Research Zone, whale alerts, and 10 watchlists.

**Q: What is the MCP server?**
A: Model Context Protocol server exposing 24 Spectre tools to AI agents like Claude and ChatGPT. Agents natively query live crypto data the same way they use filesystem or web tools. Connect at `https://mcp.spectreai.io`.

**Q: What is x402?**
A: HTTP 402 ("Payment Required") based micropayment protocol. Developers and AI agents pay per API request in cryptocurrency without needing an API key or subscription. First-mover standard for autonomous agent payments.

**Q: What chains does Spectre cover?**
A: Price data for all major chains (Ethereum, Solana, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, BNB Chain, Avalanche, Sui, Aptos, etc.). On-chain data via Bitquery spans 40+ networks.

**Q: Can I list my token on Spectre?**
A: Tokens appearing on major aggregators (CoinGecko, CoinMarketCap) or with DEX liquidity on supported chains are indexed automatically. Reach out via spectre@spectreai.io for feature placement.
